purpose: Disposable CPU training throughput; not a B/Z/R performance experiment
selection_rule: First 16 training IDs by SHA256 key cpu-throughput-sample-v1:20261024:source_id; independent of model outcomes
model: Original pretrained ViT-B16, fresh front Q/V LoRA r4 and 37-class head
augmentation: Original B only, N2 M9 bins31, fresh keyed views each timed update
optimizer: Original AdamW; logical update uses prefix of original 1110-update warmup/cosine schedule
grad_accumulation: sum CE divided by 16; step only after four microbatches

future_screen_proposal_before_timing.LR_schedule: First 185 updates of original 1110-update schedule; do not compress cosine
future_screen_proposal_before_timing.role: Early exploratory policy-choice screen, not the original 30-epoch endpoint
